name: College Craze
source:
College Craze is a female-protagonist adult dating sim and life simulation game. 
From academics, partying and hook-ups, to deciphering the interwoven mysteries lying beneath the seemingly quiet town of Sugardale, every choice matters. With a branching story structure heavily dependent on your previous choices, you'll find endless possibilities for your own college experience at Sugardale U.

Sugardale U: Work Hard. Play Harder.

Welcome to Sugardale, a mid-sized college town and home of  prestigious Sugardale University. You play as an incoming female freshman, ready to make your mark in the world.

Choose to study hard, work off campus, or party every weekend. Manage your grades, followers and bank account as you meet and interact with the 15 (and counting!) unique characters of Sugardale. 

Create your own story and get into steamy situations, all while helping (or sabotaging) your friends, keeping secrets and revealing mysteries about the town's shady happenings.
translation:
《College Craze》是一款以女性为主角的成人恋爱与生活模拟游戏。
从学业、派对和随性邂逅，到破解看似宁静的糖谷镇背后交织的谜团，每一个选择都至关重要。故事的分支走向高度取决于你先前的选择，你在糖谷大学的校园生活也因此有着无尽可能。

糖谷大学，学习要拼，玩得更尽兴。

欢迎来到糖谷，这座中等规模的大学城，也是著名的糖谷大学所在地。你将扮演一名刚入学的女大学生，准备在世界上留下属于自己的印记。

你可以努力学习、到校外打工，或每个周末都去参加派对。一边管理成绩、粉丝数与银行账户，一边结识糖谷15名各具特色的角色，并与他们互动。这个人数还会继续增加！

创造自己的故事，经历令人脸红心跳的场面，同时帮助朋友，或是从中使绊子，守护秘密，揭开镇上种种可疑事件的谜团。
